svg.title: Marketing Mix 9P
svg.desc: The nine Ps in three layers. 1960, the classic 4P: Product, Price, Place, Promotion. 1981, three more for services, making 7P: People, Process, Physical evidence. Bonus, outside the academic model, making 9P: Purple Cow and Partnership.
